build_fconv_model: build a fully convolutional encoder-decoder model using FConvModel.build_model with args and task
build_fconv_encoder: build a convolutional encoder with FConvEncoder specifying dictionary, embed_dim, and convolutions spec
build_fconv_decoder: build a convolutional decoder with FConvDecoder specifying dictionary, convolutions, and attention config
configure_fconv_architecture: configure fconv model architecture using base_architecture or fconv_wmt_en_de to set default args
review_attention_layer: review the AttentionLayer class to understand how encoder-decoder attention is computed with projections
